title: Merrill Lynch   Wealth Management   What Matters Most To You
description: What Matters Most To You?  You have important priorities, and you know what you care for most in life: let a Merrill Lynch Financial Advisor help you align your portfolio with your personal goals.   Caring For My Family  You want to be ready to support your family at every milestone. A Merrill Lynch Financial Advisor can help you manage your wealth so you can feel as prepared as possible for what may come next.   Preparing For Retirement  Will you have enough to live the retirement life you want? Let a Merrill Lynch Financial Advisor work with you to examine retirement-planning solutions and prepare you for your post-career life.   Growing My Business  These days, taking a wait-and-see approach is no way to run a small business. Your Merrill Lynch Financial Advisor can help you discover strategies for future success.   Pursuing My Dreams  With the right help, you can pursue the life you always wanted. A Merrill Lynch Financial Advisor can help you restructure your portfolio so it's designed to get both your short-term and long-term goals on track again.   Estate Planning & Philanthropy  By allocating funds wisely and employing tax-advantaged financial tools, you and your Merrill Lynch Financial Advisor can work together toward providing wealth for future generations and lifeblood for the causes that matter most to you.

visual.context: Promotional financial-advisory presentation; the slides describe services and invite the audience to engage with an advisor.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed financial-services affiliation is directly linked to a requested engagement with the advisor and to advice about managing or allocating wealth, which may merit review of the affiliation and offer context.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the presenter or advisor is actually affiliated with Merrill Lynch, whether any audience member was asked to provide money or personal information, or whether the described outcomes occurred.

visual_context_notes.observation: The visible material is formatted as a promotional presentation for wealth-management and financial-planning services, including retirement, business, and estate-planning topics.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents wealth-management services for portfolio management and planning around family, retirement, business, and estate matters. Working with a named financial advisor is described as promotional financial-services content, and the material does not describe a rapid-return promise, credential request, or payment requirement.
